browserExtension.description: The Nodetool browser extension lets the Live Browser Agent drive your own logged-in Chrome — automating media-generation sites, saving results as assets, and uploading assets into pages. Chrome can't install it for you, so load it unpacked once with the steps below.
browserExtension.attachHint: Install and attach the extension to see it here.
browserExtension.step1: Download the extension (or use the build folder below).
browserExtension.step2: Open chrome://extensions in the Chrome you use for the target sites.
browserExtension.step4: Click "Load unpacked" and select the extension folder.
browserExtension.step5: Open a site to automate, click the Nodetool extension, and press "Attach to this tab".

mcp.description: Connect AI coding assistants to NodeTool via the Model Context Protocol. When installed, Claude Code, Codex, and OpenCode can use NodeTool workflows, assets, nodes, and collections as tools.
mcp.claudeDesktopDescription: Install the NodeTool extension bundled with this app. Claude Desktop opens its install dialog; confirm it there.
mcp.bundleNotFound: Could not find the NodeTool extension bundle.
mcp.bundleOpening: Opening the NodeTool extension in Claude Desktop — confirm the install there.
mcp.bundleRevealed: Revealed nodetool.mcpb — drag it into Claude Desktop → Settings → Extensions.

descriptions.showWelcome: Start on the dashboard, with the welcome screen and templates, until getting started is finished. When off, the app opens straight into the workspace.
descriptions.soundNotifications: Play a system beep sound when workflows complete, exports finish, or other important events occur.
descriptions.automaticUpdates: Check for and download desktop app updates from the selected release channel.
descriptions.warnBeforeLargeRuns: Running a workflow executes every node at once. Show a confirmation when a run would launch many model/provider nodes that could overload an API.
descriptions.maxConcurrentRuns: Maximum number of workflow runs you can execute at once. Additional runs queue and start automatically as running ones finish.
descriptions.maxConcurrentRunsPerWorkflow: How many runs of the same workflow may run at once before further runs queue. Applies to concurrent generation (timeline, sketch); canvas runs always stay sequential.
descriptions.enableAutosave: Automatically save your workflow at regular intervals.
descriptions.autosaveInterval: How often to automatically save your workflow.
descriptions.saveBeforeRunning: Create a checkpoint version before executing workflow.
descriptions.saveOnWindowClose: Automatically save when closing the tab or window.
descriptions.maxVersionsPerWorkflow: Maximum number of versions to keep per workflow.
descriptions.closeBehaviorIntro: Choose what happens when you close the main window.
descriptions.closeBehaviorBackgroundHint: Keeps the app running in the system tray.
descriptions.nodeSelectionModeIntro: When drawing a selection box for node selections:
descriptions.nodeSelectionModeFullHint: nodes have to be fully enclosed.
descriptions.confirmLargeRunThreshold: Warn when a run would execute more than this many model/provider nodes (LLM, image, audio, API, etc.).
descriptions.leftClickDragIntro: What dragging with the left mouse button does on empty canvas.
descriptions.leftClickDragSelectHint: {{label}} left-drag draws a selection box; pan with the right or middle mouse button (and two-finger scroll on a trackpad).
descriptions.snapMovePrecision: Snap precision for moving nodes on the canvas.
descriptions.apiToken: This token is used to authenticate your account with the Nodetool API.
descriptions.apiTokenSecurity: Keep this token secure and do not share it publicly
descriptions.updateChannel: Stable follows full releases. Nightly follows prerelease nightly builds. Nightly builds default to the Nightly channel.
descriptions.brainviteApi: Use the BrainVite API to execute workflows programmatically.
